title: Long-lived authenticated session model
question: How does the engine carry an authenticated session on a portal: journaled and restored session state, page judged against its contract, or re-login on every run?

options.description: Session cookies in the journal and restored on restart; each page is judged against its contract (authenticated listing expected); session loss: declared refresh, then login
Same page contract, but no session state restored: login at the start of each run
Cookies restored; session loss detected by HTTP status (401/403) or a redirect to the login

evidence.note: five situations, three policies, two tiers

notes: Logins are counted by the site: the metric does not depend on host load, hence a decision is possible in local-dev. The contract is about the data: a login page served as 200 in place of a report must never count as an empty page.
